units.title: Number Lab
units.description: Master factors, multiples, and decimal operations so you can compute fluently and explain why your steps work.
units.finalChallenge: Plan a real budget or recipe using exact decimal computation and justify each step.

units.title: Fraction Foundry
units.description: Divide fractions and reason about parts of a whole using models and equations.
units.finalChallenge: Scale a recipe up or down with fractions and prove your amounts are correct.

units.title: Ratio City
units.description: Use ratio language, tables, and equivalent ratios to compare quantities and solve real problems.
units.finalChallenge: Design and justify a best-value mixture, recipe, or menu using ratios.

units.title: Rate & Percent Studio
units.description: Work with unit rates and percents to compare deals, speeds, and parts of a whole.
units.finalChallenge: Compare two real shopping or travel deals and defend the better value with rates and percents.

units.title: Area Architects
units.description: Find the area of triangles, quadrilaterals, and composite shapes by composing and decomposing figures.
units.finalChallenge: Design a floor plan or garden and calculate its exact area, showing how you decomposed it.

units.title: Expression Engine
units.description: Write, read, and evaluate expressions with exponents and variables, and prove equivalence.
units.finalChallenge: Model a real situation with an algebraic expression and show two equivalent forms.

units.title: Equation Quest
units.description: Solve one-step equations and inequalities and represent relationships between variables.
units.finalChallenge: Model and solve a real problem with an equation or inequality and interpret the solution.

units.title: Data Detectives
units.description: Collect, display, and summarize data with center, spread, and shape to answer statistical questions.
units.finalChallenge: Investigate a real statistical question about your life and present what the data shows.

units.title: Integer Outpost
units.description: Reason about positive and negative numbers, absolute value, and the coordinate plane.
units.finalChallenge: Map a route or temperature story using integers and the coordinate plane.

units.title: Volume Vault
units.description: Find volume of right prisms and surface area using nets, connecting 2D and 3D thinking.
units.finalChallenge: Design a package or container and calculate its exact volume and surface area.
